articles.summary: At George Washington High School in West Virginia, teacher Martin Nicolay made Thunkable the core of his intro app design course, and enrollment doubled from 45 to 90 students in one year. See how a weekly learn-by-building rhythm, a month-long final project and a practical approach to AI helped first-time coders build working apps of their own.
articles.title: How one teacher doubled enrollment in app design with Thunkable

articles.summary: Keith McGonigle had no coding background and a 10-year-old idea. With Thunkable’s AI, he built FOREcast, a 5-star golf weather app, and got it on the App Store in about a week.
articles.title: How a golfer turned a 10-year-old idea into an App Store app

articles.summary: See how Craig De Toma’s cybersecurity students build real apps in Thunkable and leave with portfolio proof employers can see.
articles.title: How Manatee Tech Uses Thunkable for Cybersecurity Careers

articles.summary: Retired Intel engineer Ananda Vardhana mentors students in rural India and Oregon, some of whom had never used a laptop. Three months later, they built working apps with Thunkable.
articles.title: How first-time students build real apps with Thunkable
